Homepage.title: Share Expenses with Friends & Family
Homepage.metaTitle: split4me · Share Expenses with Friends & Family
Homepage.description: Create a group, add shared expenses, and see exactly who owes whom. Simple, free, and no ads.

features.heading: Everything you need to settle up
features.subheading: All the tools to track shared expenses with your group, completely free.

groups.title: Shared groups
groups.description: Create a group and invite anyone with a link or a QR code — no app install required.

expenses.title: Expense tracking
expenses.description: Add expenses in seconds, attach receipts, and search through past spending.

splitting.title: Flexible splitting
splitting.description: Split evenly, by shares, by percentage, or by exact amounts.

balances.title: Balances & settlements
balances.description: See who owes whom at a glance, with suggested reimbursements to settle up fast.

currencies.title: Multi-currency
currencies.description: Pick any currency for your group and convert amounts with live exchange rates.

stats.title: Insights
stats.description: Understand spending over time, by participant, and by category.

receipts.title: Receipt scanning
receipts.description: Snap a photo of a receipt and let the app fill in the details for you.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.description: Set rent or subscriptions to repeat daily, weekly, or monthly.

step1.title: Create a group
step1.description: Name it, pick a currency, and add your participants.

step2.title: Add expenses
step2.description: Everyone adds what they paid and chooses who it was for.

step3.title: Settle up
step3.description: Balances show who owes whom, with suggested reimbursements.

Footer.tagline: Free expense sharing for friends and family.

AccountSettings.aboutBody: Create a group, log what was paid, see who owes whom. That is the whole app. Extra tools (charts, trip budget, activity) sit under More inside a group.

Onboarding.title: Three steps. Then you're done.
Onboarding.subtitle: Don't worry about the rest of the app yet. This is the whole loop.
Onboarding.step1Body: Name the trip or household and add who is in it.
Onboarding.step2Body: Type it, snap a receipt, or say it out loud on the installed app.
Onboarding.step3Body: Open Settle when you're ready to pay back. That's it.
Onboarding.pwa1Title: Set the bill with your friends
Onboarding.pwa1Body: Manage bills with friends more easily — one app, no spreadsheet.
Onboarding.pwa2Body: Type it, snap a receipt, or say it. Everyone sees the same numbers.
Onboarding.pwa3Body: Open Settle to see who owes whom, then mark it paid. Done.
